_provenance.contract: GENERATED. Do not hand-edit. Regenerate from the source drop with schema_extract.py. If a value here disagrees with a guide, this file wins and the guide is stale.

_contract.purpose: Every export from app/drizzle/constants.ts with its value, kind and the doc comment above it.
_contract.kinds: number|string|boolean|list|array_expr|expr. `value` present only when statically resolvable; `raw` is always the source text.
_contract.local_enums: Entries carrying `source` are const arrays defined inside a validator file, not constants.ts. They are folded in here so every enum_ref in 45c/45d resolves in one place.

RECRUIT_MILESTONE_STATUSES.doc: Outcome recorded for each (recruit, rank) milestone; only PAID moved reputation. PRE_EXISTING: the rank was already held when milestones were introduced. INELIGIBLE: the referral is ineligible, or has no eligibility record. NO_RECRUITER: the recruiter account no longer exists.

RECRUIT_ELIGIBILITY_REASONS.doc: Why a referral is (in)eligible for rank milestone rewards. Internal: the recruitment page only says whether a recruit is eligible, never which account or IP matched. IP_NOT_SHARED / IP_UNKNOWN: eligible at signup (no match / no client IP on the request). SHARED_IP: the signup IP was already recorded for another account. SELF_REFERRAL: the account used its own recruitment link. BACKFILL_*: referral

COPY_MAX_TAGS.doc: Maximum number of effects the `copy` / `mirror` tags may transfer. This is a PERSISTENT, per-caster ceiling: at most this many copied effects may be active on the caster (mirrored on the target) at once, across any number of casts.

[
  ["increasedamagegiven", "decreasedamagetaken"],
  ["lifesteal"],
  ["absorb", "reflect"],
  ["shield"], // Static HP must not compete with percentage-based absorb/reflect power.
  ["increaseheal"],
  ["increasestat"],
]
COPY_PRIORITY_TIERS.doc: Commitment-priority tiers for the `copy` tag (opponent buffs -> self), highest commitment first. The array index of a tier IS its rank. Same-tier types are independent slots, tie-broken by effect power.  NOTE: This is unrelated to `sortEffects` round-application ordering. These tiers only govern copy/mirror *selection* — which effects are eligible and which win the capped slots.

MIRROR_PRIORITY_TIERS.doc: Commitment-priority tiers for the `mirror` tag (own debuffs -> target). Only the named types are ranked; any other mirror-eligible negative type falls to a tail rank (supplied by the caller) and is tie-broken by power.

COPYABLE_EFFECT_TYPES.doc: Effect types the `copy` tag may transfer (flattened copy priority tiers).

TRANSFER_EXCLUDED_SOURCE_TYPES.doc: Source (`fromType`) origins that copy/mirror never transfer — passive/gear effects are not stealable/reflectable. Shared by both tags. Keep in step with the passive/pre-battle sources in `persistentEffectSourceTypes` (tags.ts) and `getEffectStage` (util.ts): a source those treat as passive belongs here too.

MIRROR_EXCLUDED_EFFECT_TYPES.doc: Negative effect TYPES the `mirror` tag never reflects onto the target (raw damage, hard control, and non-transferable mechanics). This is the effect-type axis (`e.type`) — distinct from `TRANSFER_EXCLUDED_SOURCE_TYPES`, which excludes by source origin (`e.fromType`); the two lists are not interchangeable. `wound` is intentionally NOT here — it is mirror-eligible.

STORE_REP_PRODUCTS.doc: Consumable reputation bundles.  Store purchases need fixed price points, so these replace the web's free-form amount. The rep totals are `dollars2reps(usd)` at the current web rate, which means in-app and web buy the same reputation for the same dollars and the store's cut is absorbed rather than passed on.
